en.abdullah-al-shahin: (3) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan from Abdurrahman bin Abu Najran from Ali bin Mahziyar from Hammad bin Eessa from Ibraheem bin Umar al-Yamani that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said:
“The man of this matter disappears twice.” Also he had said: “Al-Qa’im will rise and he has never paid any homage to anyone on the earth.”
